content: Jesús sogdebalid: —Napira an bemarga soged, gwenna-gwenna bemar-wegi-bukmalad burgosulid, amba-dula-gudii Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaid bela e-ganguedba-dani be dakedsemalad.
Jesús-e-san-gwagsad

A-ibanergwad-sorbali (6), Jesús na e-sapingan-warbaa eba sesgusad: Pedro, Jacobo, degi, Juan. Geb yar-matusulidse bachikii, amarbi eba nadegusmalad. Jesús yar-birgi-gwichi, amar-asabin e-san-dakleged gwagdegusad.
E-mor, isedar-dagudik dakar-dakar-gae dakle naded. Dule napneggi ayobi geg-mor-sibudik enuked.
Geb Jesús-sapingan-warbaagwad dulemar-epenne-dula-gudigusmalad dakarmalad, Elías, degi, Moisés. Amar Jesúsʼmala sunmakgwichid.
Geb Pedro Jesúsʼga sogded: —Odurdaked-saila, wegi anmar gudiid, we nueddo. Anmar neg-matargana-gwapaa sunna sobmalad: Gwagwen bega, baid Moisésʼga, degi, baidbali Elíasʼgarmo.
Ar Jesús-sapingan bela gwakidmalad. Pedro yogasaar gole-gole gwisgusad.
Geb agine, mogir emar-birgi nagunonikid. Negsichii nadsunnad. A-mogir-imbaba gayaburba gollalid: “We, An-Machi-sabedi gued. A, be nue itomar.”
Jesús-sapingan ukiar e-dikarba-atakdemargu, unnila Jesúsʼbi walagwen-gwichi dakarmalad, dule-bamaladdi bar daksasurmalad.
Yargi aidedanimargu, Jesús e-sapinganga igar-uksad, bemar ibmar-daksamaladi mer emarga sogmaloye. Geb ani Dule-Machi, an burgwisar, geb an gannar-durgusad-sorbardi, be sunna sogmarye.
Agala na emarbi wisi gudigusmalad. Degi-inigwele, na muchub-muchub egisnanai-guarmalad, wede burgwisar-gannar-durgued ibi nue-obarye.
Jesúsʼse egichiarmalad: —¿Ibiga Garda-Narmaked-Dulemar soge, Elías-inse Mesías-idu bina danigweloye?
Jesús, abin-imaksad: —Ar napiragwa Elías-inse nonikoed, adi, bela igar-nabogegar. Deginbali, ¿Bab-Dummad-Gardagi sognaisursi? Ani Dule-Machi, nue ise-wilegar guoye, degi, isdar dakmarbaloye.
Degisoggu, an bemarga sogsundo, bato Elías arbi. Igi Bab-Dummad-Gardagi egi narmakar-nai, deyobi, dulemar, imakbiedba imaksamalad.
Jesús, machigwa-niaburba-nikad nudaksad

Jesús na e-sapingan-warbaagwadmala e-sapingan-baigan-bukwadse modapmargu, dule-bukidar e-sapingan-ebirbukwa dakdapmalad. Deginbali, Garda-Narmaked-Dulemar e-sapingan-bamalad-ebo abin-abin-imaknanai daknonibalid.
Dulemar Jesús-nonikid-dakarmargua, geger dakdemalad. Geb Jesúsʼga be-dog-nued-sogeye-sogega ese duurmakarmalad.
Jesús e-sapinganse egichisided: —¿Ibi igargi bemar Garda-Narmaked-Dulemar-ebo abin-abin imaknanai?
Dule-wargwen dulemar-abargi-gwichid gollalid: —Odurdaked-saila, an wegi an-machi begala sedanikid, ar ade, an-machigi niaburba-geg-sunmaked maid.

An-machigi nia nagunonikir, aimukud-daed. Wii maku-maku guardaed, nugar ogornagusdabalid, degi, gannarkwaa megisdabalid. Be-sapinganga an sogsanad, bemar an-machigi-niaburba-maid onoye. Degi-inigwele, be-sapingan gwen nia-onossurmalad.
Jesús, abin-sogded: —¡Bemar Bab-Dummadgi-bengumalad-dulemar! ¿Sanagwadse an bemar-abargi gudiguoe? ¿Sanagwadse be ibmar durdakmaloe? Anga be-machigwa be seda.

Geb degine, Jesúsʼse machigwa searmalad. Niaburba Jesús-daksagu, machigwa-binnasur-wawanmakega imaksad. Degisoggu, machigwa napagi aimukussunnad, geb napagi bindu-bindu-mai, gaya-yaba wii makumakmai gusad.
Jesús machigwa-e-babse egichided: —¿Wede sana bei weyob-guali? Machigwa-e-bab, abin-sogded: —Bipigwad-akar weyob gualid.
Imbagwena niaburba machigwa-oburgwega, soo-yagi, degi, dii-yagi omukudaed. Ar be sunna anmar-bendakele, be wile anmar-dake, be anmar-bendake.
Jesús, abin-sogded: —¿Ibiga be anga soge, be sunna an-bendaksar-sogeye? ¡Dule-Bab-Dummadgi-bensulidga, bela ega ibmar sunna gued!
Geb degine, machigwa-e-bab binnasur-gote sogded: —An wisi be sunna an-bendaked, an be-bensulid. ¡Be an-bendake! ¡Bur bule mer-begi-bengued be an-imake!

Jesús e-dikarba dule-bukidar-ambikumai-dakargu, niaburbaga binnasur sogded: —Niaburba-dule-geg-sunmaksaed, degi, dule-uaya-yallir-sabalid, an bega soged, we-machigwagi be noe, mer be gannar bar ese dognoniko.
Niaburba binnasur goted, degi, binnasur machigwa-wawanmakega imaksagu, geb egi noded. Geb machigwa burgwaleyob megisad. Degisoggu, dule-bukidar sogdemalad: “Machigwa burgwis maiye.”
Ar Jesúsʼdi argangi machigwa-gasgu, ogwichis imaksad. Geb machigwa gwisgusad.
A-sorbali, Jesús negyaba-dogsagua, e-sapingan bachikii ese egichiarmalad: —¿Ibiga anmardi geg we-niaburba onogusa?
Jesús, abin-sogded: —Nia-wegiimalad, unnila Bab-Dummadse-goledgi, degi, mas-gunsuli-gudiguedgi onoleged.
Jesús na e-burgoedgi gannar sunmaksad
Agi-gudii Jesús na e-sapinganmala nadmargu, Galilea-yalaganba nasmalad. Jesús, dule gwen-e-wisgubisur abesad, ede nadapye.
Ade, e-sapingan-odurdakdiid, ega sogdiid: “Ani, an Dule-Machi, dulemarga uklegoed, degi, dulemar an-oburgwemaloed. Geb an burgwisad-sorbali, ibapaagi an gannar durguoed.”
E-sapingandi nue-aku-itomalad, wede ibi nue emarga obare. Dobedbali Jesúsʼse gwen egichissurmalad.
¿Doa bur-dule-dummadi?
Jesús na e-sapinganmala Capernaúm-neggweburse nonimalad. Geb negyaba-dogsagu, Jesús e-sapinganse egichialid: —¿Ibigi bemar igarba na abin-abin imakdani gusmala?
E-sapingandi gwen abin-imaksasurmalad. Ar ade, igarba na abin-abin imakdani gusmalad, doa bur-dummadga guodibeye.
Geb Jesús sigisgua, e-ambe-gakabogwadse (12) gochad, amarga sogded: —Dule-wargwen dule-iduedga-gubiele, bela-aimar-sorbalidga guergebed, degi, bela-aimar-maiga guergebbalid.
Geb Jesús mimmi-wargwen-susgua, e-sapingan-abargi mimmi-ogwichisad. Geb Jesús mimmi-angaagwar-gasgua, sogded:
—Ar dule-wargwen we-mimmiyobid-wargwen an-nuggi abingaele, an-abinganaiyob gunaid. Ar dule-gwensak an-abingaele, anbi an-abingasulid, dule-an-barmialid abinganaibalid.
Anmargi-yoledisurmaladi, anmarba-naid

Jesús-e-sapin-wargwen, Juanʼye-nugad Jesúsʼga sokalid: —Odurdaked-saila, anmar dule-wargwen-daksado be-nuggi niamar-onodii. Ar anmar-sordasursoggu, anmar ega sogsad, mer be Jesús-nuggi niamar-dulemargi-maid bar onogoye.
Jesús, abin-sogded: —Mer be a-dule-ibe igar-bisgo, ar ade, dule-wargwen an-nuggi ibmar-dakledisurmalad-imakdiile, a-dule geg angi ichakwa-sunmaknai gued.
Ar dule anmargi yoledisulile, a-dule, anmarba naido.
”Napira an bemarga soged, ar bemar Cristo-sapinga-gued-ular, dule-wargwen an-nuggi bemarga nog-gwagwen dii uksale, a-dulega, Bab-Dummad bur bule ibmar ukoed.
Aimar-isguega-imaked
”Ar dule-wargwen, we-mimmi-burwigana-angi-bensur-gudidiid isguega-imaksale, we-dulega bur-nuedirdo, akwamuu-dummad e-dukargi ega nasikmalar, degi, demar-wilase metemalar.
Ar be-argan isguega be-imakdibe, bur be sike. Ar argan-warbo-nika nia-negse-naedba, bur nuedid, argan-wargwen-nika dulagudigued. Ar nia-neggindi,
”Ar be-nag isguega be-imakdibe, bur be sike. Ar nag-warbo-nika nia-negse-naedba, bur nuedid, nag-wargwen dulagudigued. Ar nia-neggindi,
”Ar be-ibya isguega be-imakdibe, bur be be-ibya onoge. Ar ibya-gwabo-nika nia-negse-naedba, ibya-gwagwen-nika Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaidse-doged bur nuedid.
Ar nia-neggindi,
Isaías 66:24
”Ar igi-ibmar baluba-narilege, deyobi anmar belagwapa soogi-wilubdaklegega balugi maglegoed.
”Balu ibnuedid. Ar balu sayee naderdi, ¿igi be bar balu-balu gannar saosunna? Geg be sae. Degisoggu, balu-nuedyob be gumar, adi, na be muchub-muchub bogidik-gudii gumalagar.”
